name: town-preset-starter
about: Starter town preset (#132): a fresh profile whose town has only the intro mission's reward flag mission_story_intro_find_npcs, set with `townflag` (TownRecord.SetTownFlag) the way the play builder does, then saved. After a fresh boot the flag reads back, the town has no buildings, and the intro is skipped: no intro Adam (npc_misc_adam_intro), but the post-intro Adam and the builder.

steps.name: town flag mission_story_intro_find_npcs survived save and quit
town tiers after a fresh boot (no buildings)
intro skipped: no intro Adam in town
intro skipped: the post-intro Adam in town
intro skipped: the builder in town
